claims: Amy Madigan won the 2026 Oscar for Best Supporting Actress for her role as Aunt Gladys in Weapons.
Elle Fanning was nominated for the 2026 Best Supporting Actress Oscar for Sentimental Value.
Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas was nominated for the 2026 Best Supporting Actress Oscar for Sentimental Value.
Wunmi Mosaku was nominated for the 2026 Best Supporting Actress Oscar for Sinners.
Teyana Taylor was nominated for the 2026 Best Supporting Actress Oscar for One Battle After Another.
Amy Madigan's win for Weapons was her first Oscar.
Amy Madigan's Oscar win came 40 years after her 1986 nomination for Twice in a Lifetime.
Amy Madigan broke the record for the longest gap between nominations before a win, as noted by The Guardian.
Fox News reported that the 2026 Best Supporting Actress category featured multiple first-time nominees, including Teyana Taylor, Wunmi Mosaku, Elle Fanning, and Inga Ibsdotter Lilleaas.
Teyana Taylor won a Critics Choice Award.
Teyana Taylor won a Golden Globe.
